name: sol_defi_lsd_4
description: Arbitrary/unchecked exchange rate used when processing queued LSD withdrawals
question: The source file in `source` implements queued withdrawal processing for a liquid staking derivative and computes or accepts the exchange rate used to settle a queued withdrawal via a caller-supplied parameter, an admin-set variable, or a different calculation path than the one used when the withdrawal was queued, rather than deriving it from the same canonical on-chain exchange-rate source used at queuing time, allowing the settlement value paid to withdrawers to be manipulated or rugged; this excludes designs where the processing function recomputes the exchange rate identically to withdrawal creation using the same trusted on-chain state/oracle with no externally influenceable override.
criteria: processWithdrawals(uint256 exchangeRate) accepts an exchange rate parameter from the caller and uses it directly to compute the withdrawer's payout
finalizeWithdrawal() reads a mutable admin-settable storage variable like manualExchangeRate for payout calculation instead of recalculating it from vault assets/shares
completeQueuedWithdrawal() calls a different rate-computation function (e.g. getRateFast()) than the one used in requestWithdrawal() (getRateCanonical()), producing inconsistent valuations
the withdrawal settlement logic multiplies shares by a rate value passed in calldata without validating it against the vault's actual totalAssets/totalSupply ratio
